results.correct_value: Two distinct lines: Rainy Pass PCT lot -> forest -> meadow basin ~6,100 ft -> west ridge; SR-20 turnout 3.1 mi east -> meadow -> south ridge at 6,180 ft. The itinerary/timing follow the south-ridge line, so their start is set to the turnout; pitch_detail step 1 drops the forest/downed-log detail of the other line.
results.evidence: One route description puts the start at a turnout 3.1 mi past Rainy Pass (0.7 mi before Blue Lake TH, 5,000 ft), boot path through a meadow, rising traverse to the level south ridge at 6,180 ft. A trip report starting at Rainy Pass by Road 600 climbs steep forest to a meadow basin near 6,100 ft and goes up the west ridge. So the itinerary mixed the two. The Trailhead waypoint pin (Rainy Pass) is out of scope; it remains the primary variant's trailhead.
